userInputText: Toaster Dash: Adventure in the world of cakes! Prepare for sensational dashes and bake delicious cakes! Can you become a genius master chef?Toaster Dash: Get ready for a world of fast-paced action with a running toaster! That's right, you heard right! In Toaster Dash, you will control a lightning-fast toaster, zipping through challenging levels.With adorable graphics, lifelike sounds, and irresistibly engaging gameplay, this dash game promises to bring ultimate entertainment moments. Prepare yourself, hold the steering wheel tightly, and guide your toaster through a series of dangerous obstacles to reach the finish line safely. Do you have what it takes to become a bread-baking master with Toaster Dash? Let's toast it up!The Creative GameplayYou move the toaster right, left, up, or down to perform different tasks. You need to avoid obstacles like forks, spiked donuts, and more. At the same time, try to collect all the slices of bread, jam, butter, and other cooking ingredients to score high.Then, use the points earned to upgrade the toaster, which increases your chances of survival and completes levels faster. Remember that only when you complete the mission in the previous level can you continue. Furthermore, pay attention to the winning time so you can do it again and optimize your score.How to ControlTo control the main character, hold down and move the mouse to orient the dash. You need to pay attention to the entity's dash force to reach the desired location accurately.More Dash GamesEgg DashGeometry WorldSlidee
